title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026
excerpt: Back in Hall 5.1 for our third year with our own stand, with more experience, a clearer focus and particularly rewarding conversations.
image_alt: Our team at our stand in Hall 5.1, Frankfurt Book Fair 2026
body: [Frankfurt Book Fair 2026](/fairs-events/frankfurter-buchmesse-2026/) brought an earlier October gathering and a new hall layout that kept everyone on their toes, quite literally, as publishers, agents, authors, illustrators and translators comfortably reached their daily 10,000 steps. Amid the changes, we welcomed colleagues back to our familiar spot in Hall 5.1 for our third year with our own stand. Arriving with more experience and a clearer focus, we found this year’s conversations particularly rewarding, offering a chance to reflect on how far Epsilon Publishing Group has come in international publishing. From [the excitement of our first stand](/news/frankfurt-book-fair-2024/) to an increasingly established network of partners, Frankfurt gave us a welcome sense of progress and fresh motivation for the stories and collaborations ahead.
